title: User View
summary: User detail page with left sidebar showing user avatar, name, role chip, and detail fields (username, email, status, role, tax ID, contact, language, country). Includes a plan usage card with progress bar (86 of 100 days) and an 'Upgrade Plan' button. Right main content area has tab-like sections showing a Project List table with project name/avatar, total tasks, progress bar, and hours. Below is a User Activity Timeline with colored timeline items showing recent actions. Bottom section has an Invoice table with ID, status, total, issued date, and balance.

layout.columns: Left sidebar (~30%) with user profile card and plan card, right content area (~70%) with project table, timeline, and invoice table
